description: AUSTRALIA. Computes the duty on buying a home in a state or territory (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, TAS, ACT, NT; not SA, whose rate pages Payotte could not read) with first home buyer, principal residence, foreign buyer (surcharge and FIRB fee) and new home options, plus land titles registration fees. Rates as on payotte.com/australia; warnings list every assumption and any upper-limit figure.

first_home_buyer.description: Eligible for the state first home buyer exemption or concession.

foreign_buyer.description: Foreign buyer under state law: surcharge and FIRB fee added, concessions not applied.

new_home.description: New dwelling or vacant land (QLD first home concession, FIRB fee scale).

principal_residence.description: The home will be the principal place of residence.

state.description: NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT or NT (or the full name).

name: purchase_duty_au
title: Australian transfer (stamp) duty on a home, by state
